notes.compat: Labels 0-11 are identical to labels_11class.json, so an 11-class consumer can read a 13-class mask by treating 12 and 13 as background.
notes.synovial: 12 and 13 are the MOAKS substrates for synovitis on non-contrast PD: Hoffa-synovitis is graded from fat pad signal change, effusion-synovitis from fluid volume. Neither label is synovial membrane, which non-contrast PD cannot resolve.
